title: Thousands flock to see Greece’s annual 'pink veil' of peach blossoms
summary: Visitors from across Greece but increasingly from across Europe as well are flocking to see the blossoming peach trees in the Veria region, located roughly 72km west of the country's second city Thessaloniki.
